label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Rick, I need to say this once, clearly, because I’m really pissed and I don’t want to turn this into a screaming match.

You promised Gary Pruitt I’d do his house in Chandler off Ray Rd for 1%—a “family rate”—without ever asking me. My listing side is 2.5%. I have never quoted 1% to anyone. I spent Saturday, Nov. 7 on it: pulled comps, did the walkthrough, printed a full listing packet. About six hours of work plus the drive from north Phoenix. Gary texted Sunday night that he’s going with ListLite flat fee, $3,995, “no hard feelings.” When I called you, you said, “That’s business, sis, can’t win ’em all.” That’s not business. That’s you volunteering my time and my commission.

And this morning you texted that Denise wants to “pick my brain” about her rental and you already gave her my cell. Same thing as your softball guy two years ago. I let it go then. I’m not letting it go again. You get to look like the big shot with your friends and I do the work for free.

I’m not mad at Gary. I’m mad at you. Here’s what stops now: no more handing out my number, no more quoting my commission, no more volunteering my time. Ask me first. Every time. I’m not calling Denise. You can tell her.

I’m happy to help family with advice—Mom, your kids, anybody—no charge. That’s different.

I’m still coming to Thanksgiving at your place. I’m not trying to blow us up. But I’m not pretending this is fine either. Read this, sit with it, and let’s talk before the holiday.
